Personal project

Personal Developer Portfolio

From an earlier Laravel and Blade portfolio to a static site that works on GitHub Pages.

Context
Personal portfolio
Technology
HTMLCSSJavaScriptGitHub Pages
Source
Portfolio case
My roleTechnical approachResultDemonstration & evidence

The problem

The portfolio needs to make my experience understandable quickly and give each project a direct, shareable link. It also needs to work without a PHP server.

My role

My earlier portfolio used Laravel and Blade. This redesigned static edition was created with AI assistance; it presents my projects and preserves their existing URLs.

Technical approach

The current site uses semantic HTML, shared CSS and a small JavaScript enhancement for project filters and mobile navigation. A Python build script renders pages from central project content. The published output needs no server, runtime dependencies or build service.

Challenges & decisions

GitHub Pages can serve the site under a repository subdirectory. Relative asset and page links avoid depending on the domain root. Project text and navigation are rendered into the HTML, so the primary content remains available without JavaScript.

Result

A responsive portfolio with direct case-study URLs, an up-to-date software CV, accessible navigation and email contact. It makes professional software work the main entry point, with game projects available separately.

How the pieces connect

  1. Central project content
  2. Static page generator
  3. HTML / CSS / JavaScript
  4. GitHub Pages

Simplified conceptual workflow. Not an exact internal architecture.

Demonstration & evidence

The original public repository documents the earlier versions. This redesign should be attributed separately from my original work; it is not evidence that I independently authored every part of this new design.
